chapters.title: The shift from GP to Business Central

features.name: Cross-skill program
features.description: A Microsoft program designed to help partners transition consultants from Dynamics GP to Business Central, enabling them to support customer migrations from GP to BC.

quotes.text: We have 100 GP customers to move in 4 years, so the cross-skill program is essential to our growth.
quotes.why_it_matters: Quantifies the business imperative: the company has a major migration volume that requires the cross-skill program to be successful.

quotes.text: I did not think that the cross-skill program would be this easy. The people that went through the training are raising their hands.
quotes.why_it_matters: Shows the program exceeded expectations in terms of ease of adoption and participant enthusiasm.

quotes.text: they want to hit the ground running our people really feel like we're behind them and supporting them in telling them
quotes.why_it_matters: Demonstrates that the program creates engagement and a sense of company investment in employee development.

quotes.text: Cross-skill program sets up Grayhawk for success in the future by putting us in the best position to help our customers succeed.
quotes.why_it_matters: States the strategic value proposition: enables the partner to better serve customers during migration.
